resources.string: Text to search, translate, or share
Tap an icon, or move around the center and release to execute. A first press in blank space outside the wheel moves its center. Moving too far away cancels selection; move back to continue.
A black-and-white weapon wheel over a hazy backdrop. Live background blur is used when supported, while the wheel stays sharp. Enabled by default. Turn it off to use the orange halo.
In supported apps, select text and choose ActionHalo from the text menu. You can also share text to ActionHalo.
You do not need to grant access again. Check the current service connection on the home screen. Open the system list only if you want to change the system permission.
Let the halo follow your selection

When enabled, ActionHalo uses Android accessibility access to read selected text and its position in other apps and show the action halo. Password fields are excluded. Selected text is processed temporarily on your device and is not saved or logged. Only an action you tap can send that text to the website or app you choose.\n\nThis feature is optional. Text-menu and share actions work without this permission. You can turn automatic mode off here at any time.
Long press and drag an action to reorder it. Use ⋮ to move it up or down, or edit website names, URLs and icons. Change the number per page under Halo atmosphere.
Use an http or https URL with {text} where the selected text should go. Text is encoded automatically.
Action saved and enabled. Additional actions appear on the next page.
Enter a name and a valid http(s) URL containing {text}.
No account. No selection history.\nText only leaves your device when you choose an external action.
